file_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/55049/1_55049_init.xlsx'

# Read sheets into dataframes for calculation
df_book1 = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='book1')
df_book2 = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='book2')

# Identify columns to sum in book2: H, I, J (indices 7, 8, 9)
# Column A is index 0
cols_to_sum = [df_book2.columns[7], df_book2.columns[8], df_book2.columns[9]]
df_book2['sum_val'] = df_book2[cols_to_sum].fillna(0).sum(axis=1)
sum_map = df_book2.set_index(df_book2.columns[0])['sum_val'].to_dict()

# Update book1 sheet
ws_book1 = wb['book1']

# Target range: 'book1'!B3:B23
# Row 3 in Excel is row_idx 3 in openpyxl
for row_idx in range(3, 24):
    # Get the Place value from column A (col 1)
    place_val = ws_book1.cell(row=row_idx, column=1).value
    if place_val in sum_map:
        val = sum_map[place_val]
        # Write literal value (int or float)
        ws_book1.cell(row=row_idx, column=2).value = int(val) if val == int(val) else float(val)
    else:
        ws_book1.cell(row=row_idx, column=2).value = 0

# Save the resulting spreadsheet
output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/55049_0_13c6370d/1_55049_output.xlsx'
wb.save(output_path)",
